caption: The video captures an elevated, wide view of a forested ravine where a tall waterfall plunges down a grey, moss-fringed rock face on the left into a dark pool below. The white, silky column of falling water holds the same vertical streak pattern throughout, its smooth, blurred texture reading as a steady cascade. At the base, the splash and mist form a bright plume where the flow meets the pool. A bright green mossy hillside fills the center, while dense conifer trees blanket the background and right slope. On the right, a narrow creek winds past small white rapids that keep a consistent texture and position. The composition stays fixed, with the rendered water surfaces the only elements that suggest flow.
